reviewType: supplemental independent rendered-image review of actual full-course context
reviewer: visual_a; independent of fragment B visual-fix author

evidenceBinding.source: Actual full-course browser_check.js capture of the candidate bundle, not the isolated focused model fixture. Screenshot filenames and SHA-256 values below bind each inspected view.

method: Each distinct full PNG was visually inspected through the image viewer in contact sheets. Grouping was allowed only for exact whole-file SHA-256 identity. Mobile images were displayed at native width; desktop images proportionally reduced without cropping the model region, controls, descriptions or notes. All source and sheet hashes were checked again after inspection.
checked: no visible label collisions with lines or circles
actual case controls display and wrap correctly
initial, step and alternate scenes remain legible
open drawing tasks retain their intended instructions
limits: Source/math review was already completed and is not repeated or newly claimed here.
This report judges actual captured model pixels and case controls. The root full-course browser gate separately records navigation, step flows, automatic geometry checks and interactions.
No external-provider, merge or publication approval is claimed.
